biotools.summary: GenXflo is a no-code visual Nextflow pipeline builder for bioinformatics. Users design workflows on a drag-and-drop canvas and export clean, production-ready Nextflow DSL2 code. Supports Docker containerisation, local, HPC, and cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and includes AI-assisted workflow validation.
